chinese: 祭司：你怎么——？哦，只是在处理今早礼拜收上来的一笔“奉献”。

chinese: 祭司：无知的东西……我是图勒大祭司，不是什么牧师。

chinese: 祭司：坐下吧，孩子，让我用圣光开导你。

chinese: 祭司：后来，王国覆灭，大海收回了属于它的一切。

chinese: 祭司：可悲的是，我们背离了纯正的血统。\n千百年来，雅利安人与那些血统污浊之人不断混杂。

speaker: Priest

chinese: 祭司：如今，我们终于找到了伟大领袖的头骨，它就在这里，深埋在地下。

chinese: 祭司：它本就该属于雅利安人。

chinese: 莱恩：看得出来，这套鬼话你是一句不落地全信了，谁都有犯蠢的时候。

chinese: 祭司：你竟敢怀疑？竟敢质疑天意？

english: Rayne: I question harebrained ideas propagated by half-wits like you.
chinese: 莱恩：我质疑的是你这种白痴到处散播的蠢话。

speaker: Priest
english: Priest: Enough of your insolence.  I will prove Aryan superiority to you.
chinese: 祭司：放肆！我会亲自向你证明雅利安人的优越。
莱恩：听说过“越缺什么，越爱显摆”吗？

speaker: Priest
english: Priest: I will put an end to your impudent prattle.
chinese: 祭司：我要让你再也说不出这些狂言。

chinese: 莱恩：恐怕没戏，倒是你，很快就听不见了。

chinese: 祭司：我要把你的脑浆涂满整面墙！

chinese: 莱恩：再加把劲儿吧，我还是不怎么信服。

chinese: 莱恩：放心，你要去的地方暖和得很。

english: Rayne: Maybe there's some paperwork on all the hogwash he's been rattling on about.

english: Rayne: I should search more thoroughly.

chinese: 莱恩：我找到了遗物的资料。你说得没错，他们在谋划一件大事。

chinese: 暗影人：还有一件事，摧毁通信中心，不能让他们发报求援。祝你好运。通话结束。

chinese: 暗影人：阿根廷海岸的一座大型潜艇船坞和采矿基地。

chinese: 暗影人：纳粹花了十五年加固那座基地，几乎没人进得去，但我们别无选择。\n能突破他们防线的，只有你。

chinese: 暗影人：它的创始人兼首领是尤尔根·沃尔夫。

english: DarkMan: The file you have lists many G.G.G. officers and their S.S. conspirators, including Jurgen Wulf.
chinese: 暗影人：你拿到的文件里列出了许多反幽灵小组军官，\n以及与他们勾结的党卫队成员，\n其中也包括尤尔根·沃尔夫。

english: DarkMan: You are to eliminate all of these targets to prevent further...supernatural ambitions.
chinese: 暗影人：你必须清除名单上的所有目标，免得他们继续实现那些……超自然野心。

english: DarkMan: But be careful.  Members of the G.G.G. have been experimentally enhanced and are particularly dangerous.
chinese: 暗影人：不过要小心，反幽灵小组的成员都接受过实验强化，非常危险。

english: DarkMan: Some may even be surrounded by elite G.G.G. storm troopers.
chinese: 暗影人：有些人身边甚至还有反幽灵小组的精锐突击队保护。

english: DarkMan: We've noted these members with a G.G.G. symbol on your list.
chinese: 暗影人：这些人已经在名单上用反幽灵小组的标志注明了。

english: DarkMan: Good luck.  And Rayne?  Watch yourself.
chinese: 暗影人：祝你好运。还有，莱恩，当心点。

english: Rayne: It's built right into the mountain.
chinese: 莱恩：基地直接修进了山里。

english: Rayne: Hard to tell how big the place really is.
chinese: 莱恩：根本看不出里面到底有多大。

english: Rayne: Well father, finally an ability I can use.
chinese: 莱恩：父亲，你总算留给我一样有用的本事。

english: Rayne: Next time, you bastard, I'll steal your life.
chinese: 莱恩：下次吧，混蛋，下次我会吸干你。

english: Rayne: But not today.  Somebody else needs my attention.
chinese: 莱恩：但不是今天，还有别人等着我招呼。

english: Rayne: The natives are nothing but disposable labor to the Nazis.
chinese: 莱恩：在纳粹眼里，当地人只是用完就扔的苦力。

english: Rayne: But why kill them?  Some sort of uprising?
chinese: 莱恩：可为什么要杀光他们？难道他们造反了？

speaker: Soldier1
english: Did I ever tell you about my uncle, the farmer?
chinese: 我跟你讲过我那个当农夫的叔叔吗？

speaker: Soldier2
english: No, what about your uncle the farmer?
chinese: 没有，你那个农夫叔叔怎么了？

speaker: Soldier1
english: Well, my uncle's a farmer and has this bull named "Big".  Everything about it is perfect.  Except for one thing.
chinese: 我叔叔养了一头叫“大个子”的公牛，哪儿都好，只有一个毛病。

speaker: Soldier1
english: Its eyes.  They're crossed.  My uncle knew he could win first prize at the local fair if he could only fix the Bull's eyes.
chinese: 它是斗鸡眼。我叔叔知道，只要把它的眼睛治好，它准能在当地的牲畜展上拿头奖。

speaker: Soldier1
english: He tried everything to fix it; the vet, home remedies, you name it.
chinese: 他什么办法都试过，兽医、偏方，能想到的全试了。

speaker: Soldier1
english: One day a new farmhand, who wasn't too smart, saw Big and said to my uncle:
chinese: 有一天，一个脑子不太灵光的新雇工看见“大个子”，就问我叔叔：

speaker: Soldier1
english: You want I should fix that there bull's eyes for you?
chinese: 要不我帮你把这头牛的眼睛治好？

speaker: Soldier1
english: My uncle said, "you can fix it?"  To which the farmhand said:
chinese: 我叔叔问：“你能治？”那雇工说：

speaker: Soldier1
english: Sure.  You got a lead pipe?

speaker: Soldier1
english: Yeah.  Being as my uncle he tried everything, he said, "Yeah, I guess, there's one in the shed.  I'll go get it."
chinese: 对。我叔叔反正什么都试过了，就说：“应该有，棚子里放着一根。我去拿。”

speaker: Soldier1
english: He came back and handed the pipe to the farmhand.  The farmhand took the pipe and shoved it right up Big's ass.
chinese: 他回来把铅管递给雇工。雇工接过管子，直接塞进了“大个子”的屁股。

speaker: Soldier1
english: Yeah.  But before my uncle could even say anything, the farmhand blew into the pipe as hard as he could.  Unbelievably, the bull's eyes uncrossed!
chinese: 对，我叔叔还没反应过来，雇工就对着管子拼命吹。\n你猜怎么着？那头牛的斗鸡眼真好了！

speaker: Soldier1
english: Wait, wait, I'm not done.  So the next day my uncle wants to take the bull to the fair since its eyes are now fixed.
chinese: 等等，还没讲完。第二天，眼睛既然治好了，我叔叔就准备把牛牵去参展。

speaker: Soldier1
english: But when he and the farmhand check the bull that morning, its eyes are crossed again.
chinese: 结果一早他和雇工去看，那头牛又成了斗鸡眼。

speaker: Soldier1
english: My uncle says, "Let me try that trick." He takes the lead pipe, shoves it in poor Big's rump, and blows.  Nothing happens.  He tries again.  Still nothing.
chinese: 我叔叔说：“让我试试那招。”\n他拿起铅管，塞进可怜的“大个子”屁股里，使劲一吹，没反应。\n他又吹了一次，还是没用。

speaker: Soldier1
english: He tries one more time.  The veins in his forehead and neck bulge, his face turns red, he's blowing that hard.
chinese: 他又试了一次，吹得额头和脖子青筋暴起，脸都憋红了。

speaker: Soldier1
english: Here.  Let me do it.  You're doin' it wrong.
chinese: 给我吧，我来，你的方法不对。

speaker: Soldier1
english: He then proceeds to pull the pipe out, turn it around and shove it back in.  The farmhands just about to put his mouth on the filthy pipe end-
chinese: 说着，他把管子拔出来，掉了个头，又塞了回去。\n就在他准备把嘴凑到那肮脏的管口上时——

speaker: Soldier1
english: -when my uncle says, "What the hell are you doing, boy?" and the farmhand replies:
chinese: ——我叔叔问：“你他妈在干什么？”雇工回答：

speaker: Soldier1
english: You don't think I want your germs do ya?
chinese: 你总不会想让我沾上你的细菌吧？

speaker: Soldier2
english: That didn't really happen did it?

speaker: Soldier2
english: Oh ja, I heard that one before.

chinese: 已消灭布劳恩·梅凯上尉

english: Elite soldiers can block your blade and harpoon attacks. You can identify them by their uniforms. Weaken them or attack from behind to feed on them.
chinese: 精锐士兵可以格挡刀刃和鱼叉攻击，你可以通过制服辨认他们。\n先削弱他们，或从背后下手，才能吸食他们。

chinese: 经地下室前往科学实验室

english: Seek out targets in other areas.
chinese: 前往其他区域搜寻目标

Rayne: I haven't met all the objectives.
Rayne: There are still targets in this area.
chinese: 莱恩：这片区域还有目标没解决。

english: Rayne: No, I've got things to do first.
chinese: 莱恩：不行，我还有事要办。

english: Rayne: No, I'm not done here.
chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里的事还没完。

speaker: PAVoice
english: P.A. Voice: Code Zeus! Repeat: Code Zeus!
chinese: 广播：宙斯警报！重复，宙斯警报！

speaker: PAVoice
english: P.A. Voice: Science lab security breach!  All personnel, abandon pursuit! Report to the science lab immediately!
chinese: 广播：科学实验室发生安全事故！所有人员停止追击！立即前往科学实验室！

speaker: PAVoice
english: P.A. Voice: Get over here now!  They're loose!  The Daem- aargh!
chinese: 广播：马上过来！它们跑出来了！那些魔——啊啊啊！

english: Rayne: Sounds like they have their own problems.  I'm done here.
chinese: 莱恩：听起来他们自顾不暇了，我这里也办完了。

english: Rayne: I need to get into the basement.  An officer should have what I need.
chinese: 莱恩：我得进地下室，军官身上应该有我要的东西。

english: Rayne: I should search an officer's body before I go.
chinese: 莱恩：走之前，得搜一具军官的尸体。

speaker: PAVoice
english: P.A. Voice: Code Artemis!  Intruder Alert!  Kill on sight.  Repeat: Kill intruder on sight.
chinese: 广播：阿耳忒弥斯警报！发现入侵者！格杀勿论！重复，发现入侵者，格杀勿论！

english: Rayne: One down, two left in this area.
chinese: 莱恩：干掉一个，这片区域还剩两个。

speaker: SubOfficer
english: Officer: There!  The intruder is at the dock.  Do not allow her to escape!
chinese: 军官：在那里！入侵者在码头！别让她跑了！

speaker: SubOfficer
english: Officer: I've got something for you, little girl.
chinese: 军官：小姑娘，我给你准备了点好东西。

speaker: SubOfficer
english: Officer: What's wrong with you?  Kill her!  Kill her goddammit!
chinese: 军官：你们愣着干什么？杀了她！他妈的，杀了她！

speaker: SubOfficer
english: Officer: What the hell are you!?
chinese: 军官：你到底是什么鬼东西！？

speaker: BathroomOfficer
english: Officer: Heinz?  Have they caught the intruder yet?
chinese: 军官：海因茨？入侵者抓到了吗？

speaker: BathroomOfficer
english: Officer: Who's there?  I asked a question, goddamnit!
chinese: 军官：谁在那儿？我他妈问你话呢！

english: Rayne: He won't help you here.

speaker: BathroomOfficer
chinese: 军官：入侵者！拉警报！警报！

speaker: PlatformOfficer
english: Officer: Don't let her get up here!

speaker: PlatformOfficer
english: Officer: Jansen, Hermann!  Cover the catwalk.
chinese: 军官：扬森、赫尔曼！守住栈桥！

speaker: PlatformOfficer
chinese: 军官：准备“坦克杀手”火箭筒。

speaker: PlatformOfficer
english: Officer: Get me some support on the ground!  Now!
chinese: 军官：地面支援呢？马上给我派人！

speaker: PlatformOfficer
english: Officer: It's only a girl!  Take her down!
chinese: 军官：她不过是个小姑娘！干掉她！

english: Argentina Coast, 1938 - Mission briefing: A splinter group of Germany's Nationalist party, the Nazis, has become obsessed with retrieving legendary artifacts of great power, in particular, the skull of a fabled and ancient demon, Beliar.
chinese: 阿根廷海岸，1938年\n任务简报：德国民族主义政党的一个分裂派系：\n纳粹，沉迷于搜寻传说中威力无穷的遗物，尤其是远古恶魔贝利亚的头骨。

english: They believe the Skull lies buried deep in Argentina, and have constructed a fortress there, complete with a U-boat station and mining facility. BloodRayne, we cannot allow the Nazis to gain possession of the Skull of Beliar.
chinese: 他们相信头骨深埋在阿根廷，\n于是在那里修建了一座要塞，其中包括潜艇基地和采矿设施。\n莱恩，绝不能让纳粹拿到贝利亚之颅。

english: There are three officers in command of the Nazi U-boat station. You can identify them by their uniforms. Infiltrate the station and execute them.
chinese: 纳粹潜艇基地由三名军官共同指挥，你可以通过制服辨认他们。\n潜入基地，处决这三人。

speaker: Soldier2
english: Soldier: Oh God!  It hurts!  It hurts!
chinese: 士兵：上帝啊！疼死我了！疼死我了！

english: Rayne: Ungh...I should be dead.  I wish I was.
chinese: 莱恩：呃……我应该已经死了。真希望我死了。

speaker: Soldier2
english: Soldier: My legs!  They're broken!  Aaaaargggh!  My legs!
chinese: 士兵：我的腿！腿断了！啊啊啊啊！我的腿！

speaker: Soldier3
chinese: 士兵：……动不了……什么都感觉不到……

english: Rayne: Hey sweetie, let me help you ease your pain.
chinese: 莱恩：亲爱的，让我帮你解脱吧。

english: Rayne: My, you're a big one.  Mauler, I presume?
chinese: 莱恩：哟，块头不小嘛，你就是“重锤”？

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: GegenGruppenFuhrer Wulf said you might come this way.
chinese: 重锤：反幽灵小组首领沃尔夫说，你可能会从这里经过。

english: Rayne: Where is that elusive jackal?  I always seem to miss him.
chinese: 莱恩：那只躲躲藏藏的豺狼在哪儿？我怎么每次都扑个空。

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: Headed back to the Fatherland.
Rayne: He's given up on the relic?
chinese: 莱恩：他放弃那件遗物了？

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: What you have is not the only relic.  Foolish little girl.  You know nothing.
chinese: 重锤：你手里的并不是唯一一件遗物，愚蠢的小丫头，你什么都不知道。

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: Just like that stupid priest.  He knows nothing but lies.
chinese: 重锤：就和那个蠢祭司一样，他知道的全是谎言。

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: The great Beliar is the original devil.  When Mephisto fell from heaven, he usurped Beliar.  When he couldn't destroy him, Mephisto ripped Beliar into a thousand pieces and scattered him in all directions.
chinese: 重锤：伟大的贝利亚才是最初的魔王。\n墨菲斯托从天堂坠落后，篡夺了贝利亚的地位。\n他杀不了贝利亚，便将他的身体撕成一千块，撒向四面八方。

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: No one would dare seek them out.
chinese: 重锤：没人敢去寻找那些碎片。

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: No one, that is, except Jurgen Wulf and us, his Gegengheist Gruppe.
chinese: 重锤：除了尤尔根·沃尔夫，还有我们，他的反幽灵小组。

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: Do you know which relic Wulf is unearthing in castle Gaustadt right now?
chinese: 重锤：你知道沃尔夫此刻正在高施塔特城堡挖什么吗？

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: Beliar's black seething heart.  The key to ruling the world is in our own country, and Wulf will control it.
chinese: 重锤：贝利亚那颗漆黑翻涌的心脏。\n统治世界的钥匙就在我们祖国，而沃尔夫将把它掌握在手中。

english: Rayne: Yeah, we'll see about that.

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: Scared of me?  Come and fight!

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: Come down so I can squash you like a bug!
chinese: 重锤：下来！我要像捏虫子一样捏死你！

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: I will break you into little pieces.
chinese: 重锤：我要把你撕成碎片！

english: Rayne: Now you did it.  You really scared me.
chinese: 莱恩：这下糟了，你可真把我吓坏了。

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: You can't stay up there forever!
chinese: 重锤：你不可能永远躲在上面！

english: Rayne: You're a conversational genius.  Keep it up and  you'll bore me to death.
chinese: 莱恩：你真会聊天，再说几句，说不定真能把我无聊死。

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: The time for talk is past.
Rayne: Boy you're tiresome.  Guess I have no choice but to kick you till you're dead.
chinese: 莱恩：你可真烦人。没办法，我只能把你踹到断气了。

speaker: Brute
english: Mauler: I can't be beat that easily.
chinese: 重锤：没那么容易打败我。

english: Rayne: There you are.  Payback time.
chinese: 莱恩：找到你了，该算账了。

english: Rayne: That other sub's my only chance.  I've gotta sneak aboard.
chinese: 莱恩：另一艘潜艇是我唯一的机会，我得偷偷上去。

speaker: Soldier2
english: Soldier: Let's get the hell out of here.  Go get the others.  We'll finish loading the crates.  Now!  Hurry!
chinese: 士兵：快离开这里！去叫其他人，我们把剩下的箱子装完。快！赶紧！

speaker: Soldier1
english: Soldier: Yes sir!  Right away sir!

speaker: Soldier1
english: Soldier: Mein Gott! Sir!  Everyone's dead!
chinese: 士兵：我的天！长官！人全死了！

speaker: Soldier2
english: Soldier: Order from G.G.G. Oberscharfuhrer: unload the crates.
chinese: 士兵：反幽灵小组的一名党卫队高级小队长下令，把箱子卸下来。

english: Rayne: New objectives and another target list.
chinese: 莱恩：新任务，还有一份新的目标名单。

english: Rayne: "In the preliminary G.G.G. headquarters at Falkenburg a Nazi officer has your next target list...
chinese: 莱恩：“在法尔肯堡的反幽灵小组临时总部，\n一名纳粹军官手里有你的下一份目标名单……

english: Rayne: ...terminate him and obtain the file."

speaker: Daemite
english: Daemite: Nazis want to come out and play?
chinese: 魔蛭：纳粹要不要出来玩呀？

speaker: DaemiteOff
english: Officer: I'll wear you like lederhosen.
chinese: 军官：我要把你扒了做成皮裤！

english: Rayne: Whatever you are, you just said the wrong words.
chinese: 莱恩：不管你是什么东西，这句话都不该说。

english: Rayne: There must be a way through.
Rayne: Ugly bastards.  Where'd they come from?
chinese: 莱恩：丑陋的混蛋。它们是从哪儿冒出来的？

english: Rayne: I don't know what they were storing down there, but it gunked up my guns.
chinese: 莱恩：不知道他们在下面存了什么，那些黏东西把我的枪全堵住了。

english: Brigadier General Major R. Wauher Eliminated
Find East elevator and exit the Barracks.
chinese: 找到东侧电梯并离开兵营

english: Press @@harpoonbitebuttonname@@ while jumping to execute a jump-harpoon attack.
chinese: 跳跃时按@@harpoonbitebuttonname@@发动跳跃鱼叉攻击

speaker: Daemite
english: Daemite: Take deep breaths.  TAKE DEEP BREATHS!

speaker: Daemite
english: Daemite: Work or shower.  Work or shower!  Hahahahahaha!
chinese: 魔蛭：干活还是洗澡！干活还是洗澡！哈哈哈哈哈哈！

english: Rayne: Asshole.  Time to get out of here.
chinese: 莱恩：混蛋，该离开这里了。

english: Rayne: Holy shit.  What are they doing down here?
chinese: 莱恩：我操，他们在下面到底干了什么？

english: Rayne: You must be the mysterious "Kommando".
chinese: 莱恩：你一定就是那个神秘的“突击队长”。

english: Rayne: I'm sorry.  Was I talking too fast?  Can't keep the words apart?
chinese: 莱恩：抱歉，我刚才说太快了？一句都没听明白？

english: Rayne: Still thinking about the first thing I said?
chinese: 莱恩：还在琢磨我说的第一句话？

english: Rayne: I'll talk slower.  Read my lips: you're dead.  Any last words?
chinese: 莱恩：那我说慢点。看清我的嘴：你、死、定、了。还有遗言吗？

speaker: none
english: Butcheress: Kommando, Hauptmann Eckstein, rendezvous on the roof!  Our transport will be arriving shortly.
chinese: 女屠夫：突击队长、埃克施泰因上尉，到屋顶集合！\n运输机很快就到！

speaker: none
english: Butcheress: Repeat: meet on the roof immediately.
chinese: 女屠夫：重复，立即前往屋顶集合！

speaker: RoofOff
english: Officer: I got you now, bitch!  Prepare for a painful death.
chinese: 军官：抓到你了，婊子！准备受死吧！

english: Rayne: Sure.  I'm ready.  Just tell me one thing.  What the hell were you guys thinking when you made those things downstairs?
chinese: 莱恩：好啊，我准备好了。\n不过先回答我一个问题：你们造出楼下那些玩意儿时，到底在想什么？

speaker: RoofOff
english: Officer: Well, you can't say that I don't have a heart.  We didn't make them.  We woke them up when we searched for the skull of Beliar.

english: Officer: But everything went wrong.  We can't control them.
chinese: 军官：可后来全乱套了，我们根本控制不了它们。

chinese: 军官：不过，这些都与你无关了。再见，小姐。

chinese: 莱恩：不行，还需要一把控制钥匙。

chinese: 莱恩：嗯……突击队长身上肯定有控制钥匙。

chinese: 莱恩：突击队长的钥匙应该能用。

chinese: 士兵：那他妈是什么东西！？

chinese: 原住民2：不！不要！求你了！怎么都行，别这样！饶了我吧！我求求你！

chinese: 莱恩：那个金发大块头娘们也是我的目标，真想现在就过去收拾她。

english: Rayne: This is not going to hold.  Time to run!
chinese: 莱恩：这里撑不了多久，该跑了！

english: Rayne: As if it wasn't bad enough.
chinese: 莱恩：还嫌事情不够糟吗。

chinese: 莱恩：好险。快跑，莱恩，快跑！

chinese: 莱恩：该收拾那个机枪手了。

english: Rayne: Think before you act, Rayne.  Long range weapons.
chinese: 莱恩：动手前先想清楚，莱恩，得用远程武器。

english: Rayne: Let's see. Bad guys plus big guns and a long, narrow hall... Fuck.
chinese: 莱恩：我看看……一群混蛋，几挺重机枪，再加一条又长又窄的走廊……操。

english: Rayne: I'm going to need a ranged weapon, preferably one that shoots around corners.
chinese: 莱恩：我需要远程武器，最好还能拐着弯打人。

speaker: Butcheress
chinese: 女屠夫：埃克施泰因，你总算来了！突击队长呢？

speaker: Rayne
english: Rayne: Eckstein won't be answering any questions, "Butcheress".
chinese: 莱恩：埃克施泰因回答不了你的问题了，“女屠夫”。

speaker: Butcheress
english: Butcheress: We have something in common, you and I.  I am a direct descendant of Erzsebet Bathory.  You know the name?
chinese: 女屠夫：你我其实很像。我是伊丽莎白·巴托里的直系后裔，听过这个名字吗？

speaker: Butcheress
english: Butcheress: I had a feeling you'd recognize the name.  You should appreciate the lust for blood.
chinese: 女屠夫：我就知道你认得，你应该很懂那种嗜血的快感。

speaker: Rayne
english: Rayne: I don't appreciate senseless killing.  You're a monster, like those creatures down below.
chinese: 莱恩：我可不喜欢毫无意义地杀人。你就是个怪物，跟楼下那些东西没两样。

speaker: Butcheress
chinese: 女屠夫：当地人管它们叫“魔蛭”。

speaker: Soldier1
english: Soldier: No, please doctor, not me!
chinese: 士兵：不，求你了，博士，别选我！

speaker: Butcheress
english: Butcheress: First they squeeze their soft bodies into the mouth.  They secrete digestive enzymes from their skin to eat the brain.
chinese: 女屠夫：它们先把柔软的身体挤进人的嘴里，\n再从皮肤分泌消化酶，\n把大脑一点点吃掉。

speaker: Butcheress
english: Butcheress: The tail is inserted, rather forcefully, into the spinal column, tapping directly into the host's nervous system.
chinese: 女屠夫：然后把尾巴硬生生插进脊柱，直接接入宿主的神经系统。

speaker: Butcheress
english: Butcheress: They control the host body like a puppet, seeking extremes of pleasure and pain.  Mostly the easier sensation wins out: pain.
chinese: 女屠夫：它们把宿主当木偶一样操纵，逼着宿主体验极致的快感和痛苦。\n不过哪一种更容易得到，哪一种就占上风，通常都是痛苦。

speaker: Butcheress
english: Butcheress: They also reproduce asexually in the chest cavity.
chinese: 女屠夫：它们还会在胸腔里进行无性繁殖。

speaker: Rayne
english: Rayne: If you say so.  What are you going to do with them?
chinese: 莱恩：你说是就是吧，你打算拿它们怎么办？

speaker: Butcheress
english: Butcheress: Let me see.  I could keep them here and feed them with my men, or I could unleash them on your country.  Tough choice.
chinese:
女屠夫：让我想想。
可以把它们留在这里，拿我的手下喂它们；
也可以把它们放到你的国家去。
真难选啊。

speaker: Butcheress
english: Butcheress: Ha ha ha ha ha.

speaker: Butcheress
english: Butcheress: Somebody wants to meet you!
Rayne: You know, you're right.  Fascinating creatures.  I could watch them for hours.
chinese: 莱恩：你说得对，这些东西确实挺有意思，我能看它们看上一整天。

english: Rayne: I need to find that relic and destroy these "Daemites".
chinese: 莱恩：我得找到遗物，再把这些“魔蛭”全灭了。

english: Rayne: "Feuer" ...fire.  Nazis can be so helpful.
chinese: 莱恩：“Feuer”……火。纳粹有时候还挺贴心。

english: Rayne: I've gotta find a way into the mine so I can access the temple.
chinese: 莱恩：得先找到进矿井的路，才能去神庙。

english: Rayne: I'm gonna feed you to your pets, bitch!
chinese: 莱恩：我要把你喂给你那些宝贝，婊子！

english: Rayne: You've got some nice moves.  Too bad they won't save you!
chinese: 莱恩：身手不错，可惜救不了你的命！

english: You have gained the ability to perform a Level 4 Bloodrage attack!
You need explosives to blast through here.
chinese: 需要炸药才能炸开这里

english: You need a detonator to set off the explosives.
chinese: 需要起爆器才能引爆炸药

english: This corridor is flooded.  The water pumps must be off-line.
chinese: 这条走廊被水淹了，水泵应该都停了

english: This corridor is still a little flooded.  There must be another water pump.
chinese: 这里还有些积水，肯定还有另一台水泵

english: Make your way deeper into the mine.

chinese: 军官掉下了一枚起爆器！

speaker: Soldier1
english: Soldier: Set the charge!  Seal the tunnel!
chinese: 士兵：放炸药！把隧道封死！

speaker: Soldier2
english: Soldier: What do you think I'm doing here?!
chinese: 士兵：你以为我在干什么？！

speaker: Soldier1
english: Soldier: Lieutenant Strosczek and his men are still back there!
chinese: 士兵：斯特罗切克中尉和他的人还在里面！

speaker: MineOfficer
chinese: 矿区军官：他们已经完了，士兵。

speaker: MineOfficer
english: MineOfficer: Oh no!  It's her! Fall back and regroup!
chinese: 矿区军官：不好！是她！撤退，重新集结！

english: Rayne: It's me alright.  Keep running.  While you can.
chinese: 莱恩：没错，是我。继续跑啊，趁你们还跑得动。

english: Rayne: The temple must be deeper in this mine.
chinese: 莱恩：神庙肯定就在矿井更深处。

english: Rayne: The tunnel is sealed.  I need explosives and a detonator to blast my way through.
chinese: 莱恩：隧道被封死了，我得弄到炸药和起爆器，把路炸开。

english: Rayne: Dammit, no detonator.  The officer had one.
chinese: 莱恩：该死，没有起爆器，刚才那个军官身上有。

english: Rayne: Just what the doctor ordered for blocked passageways.
chinese: 莱恩：正好拿来治治这种堵路的毛病。

english: Rayne: But first I need the detonator from that officer.
chinese: 莱恩：不过得先从那个军官身上拿到起爆器。
莱恩：都装好了……最好退远点。

speaker: SoldierTargetGuard1
english: Soldier: We're all going to die!

english: Soldier: They're all over the place!

chinese: 莱恩：接下来，一个姑娘该上哪儿找爆破炸药呢？

english: Argentina Mine, 1938 - Mission Briefing: Digging for the mythical Skull of Beliar, the Nazis have uncovered something else.  Something much, much worse: ancient parasitic life forms that feed on, and take complete control over their human hosts.
chinese:
阿根廷矿井，1938年
任务简报：
纳粹在挖掘传说中的贝利亚之颅时，还挖出了别的东西，
一种糟糕得多的东西：古老的寄生生物。
它们以人类为食，还能彻底控制宿主。

english: BloodRayne, you must scout deeper into the mining facility to discover the source of these parasites.
chinese: 莱恩，你必须深入矿区，查出这些寄生生物的源头。

english: The mineshafts are heavily secured.  You'll need to find the Nazi munitions officer in the Northern Sector, kill him, and take the detonator he carries. Then find the right explosives to secure deeper access into the mines.
chinese: 矿井戒备森严。\n先找到北区的纳粹军火官，杀掉他，拿走他身上的起爆器。\n然后找到合适的炸药，炸开通往矿井深处的道路。

english: Rayne: I haven't met all the objectives.
chinese: 莱恩：任务还没全部完成。

chinese: 莱恩：这里还有目标没解决。

chinese: 莱恩：不行，我还有事要办。

chinese: 莱恩：没有起爆器，光有炸药没用。

chinese: 莱恩：现在只差更多爆破炸药。

chinese: 莱恩：没有起爆器，还是没用。

chinese: 莱恩：看着就疼。附近应该有水泵能把水抽干。

chinese: 莱恩：还不够，别的地方肯定还有水泵。

speaker: Soldier
english: Soldier1: Oh my God!  They've broken through!
chinese: 士兵1：天哪！它们冲进来了！

speaker: Soldier
chinese: 士兵2：全杀了！一个都别留！

english: Rayne: I figured I'd see you again.  This time one of us will die.
chinese: 莱恩：我就知道咱们还会再见面，不过这次，咱们俩只能活一个。

english: Rayne: This time, one of us will most assuredly die. And the other one's called Rayne.
chinese: 莱恩：这一次，绝对得死一个。至于活下来的那个？不好意思，叫莱恩。

english: Rayne: Nope. I need a control turnkey.
chinese: 莱恩：不行，我需要控制钥匙。

english: Rayne: Kommando's turnkey should do the trick.
chinese: 莱恩：突击队长的钥匙应该能用。

english: Rayne: Kommando. Long time no see.
chinese: 莱恩：好久不见了，突击队长。

english: Rayne: I love what you've done with yourself.
chinese: 莱恩：你这副新造型挺不错嘛。

english: Rayne: You got a new haircut, and your lips are all ripped and bloody.
chinese: 莱恩：换了发型，嘴也撕得血肉模糊。

english: Rayne: I guess I didn't kill you enough the first time. I won't make that mistake again.
chinese: 莱恩：看来上次我杀得还不够彻底，这次不会再犯同样的错了。

speaker: Kommando
english: Kommando: I'll wear you like lederhosen.
chinese: 突击队长：我要把你做成皮裤穿。

english: Rayne: Cute. That's the first thing you've ever said to me, and I've heard it all before. You need a better come on.
chinese: 莱恩：真可爱。你第一次跟我说话，就拿了句我早听过的台词，这搭讪水平得再练练。

english: Rayne: This time, without a doubt, one of us will die.
chinese: 莱恩：这次毫无疑问，咱们俩会死一个。

chinese: 莱恩：冷静，莱恩，你能行的。别出声，放轻脚步。

english: Rayne: That's what all the fuss is about?  A chunk of glass?
chinese: 莱恩：他们闹这么大，就为了这块玻璃？

english: Rayne: Ahhhh! The skull just holds the real relic: the eye.
chinese: 莱恩：啊！头骨只是个容器，真正的遗物是里面那只眼睛。

english: Rayne: Beliar's Eye is...it's in my head!
chinese: 莱恩：贝利亚之眼……它、它跑到我脑子里去了！

speaker: Soldier1
english: Soldier: Kruger!  Maier!  Load that thing with explosives and blow it all to hell!
chinese: 士兵：克鲁格！迈尔！给那东西塞满炸药，把这里全炸上天！

speaker: Soldier1
english: Soldier: Hurry! Hurry! Load it up!
chinese: 士兵：快！快点！把炸药装上去！

speaker: Soldier2
english: Soldier: More explosives! We need more!
chinese: 士兵：还需要更多炸药！不够！

speaker: Soldier3
english: Soldier: Cut it loose!  Now! Blow them up!
chinese: 士兵：把它弄下来！快！炸死它们！

chinese: 按@@moveAxis@@拉近或拉远视野，此模式非常适合狙击。按@@turnAxis@@转身或观察。

chinese: 步兵少尉戴维·冯·哈伯：已消灭

english: Rayne: Castle Gaustadt.  A place where nightmares are born.  Vampires have called this place home for centuries.
chinese: 莱恩：高施塔特城堡，噩梦诞生的地方。几个世纪以来，吸血鬼一直把这里当成老巢。

speaker: none
english: Rayne: But now the Germans have put up an eviction notice.  They've made some progress, but the creatures they're up against are monsters even amongst vampires.
chinese: 莱恩：可现在德国人送来了逐客令。\n他们确实取得了一些进展，不过对手就算放在吸血鬼里，也称得上怪物。

speaker: none
english: Rayne: An ancient breed of vampire, cut off from the world, where in isolation, they evolved into perfect killers.
chinese: 莱恩：那是一支与世隔绝的古老吸血鬼族群。\n长期孤立之下，它们进化成了完美的杀手。

speaker: none
english: Rayne: Daylight is fading fast.  And with it any advantage the Nazis might have had.
chinese: 莱恩：太阳很快就要下山了，纳粹的那点优势也会跟着一起消失。

speaker: none
english: Rayne: I have a new target list from the Brimstone Society.  And an official objective to stop Wulf.
chinese: 莱恩：硫磺会给了我一份新的目标名单，还有一项正式任务，阻止沃尔夫。

speaker: none
english: Rayne: Wulf already has Beliar's teeth, ribs, a hand, and an eye.  Now he's after the black heart, hidden somewhere in this castle.
chinese: 莱恩：沃尔夫已经拿到了贝利亚的牙齿、肋骨、一只手和一只眼睛，\n现在他盯上了藏在这座城堡里的黑心。

speaker: none
english: Rayne: He wants to wake Beliar in himself.  Beliar.  A demon.  A devil.  Maybe even the devil.
chinese: 莱恩：他想在自己体内唤醒贝利亚。\n贝利亚，一个恶魔，一个魔王……甚至可能就是魔鬼本身。

speaker: none
english: Rayne: Wulf can't control this kind of power.  If Beliar is woken, we're all in big trouble.
chinese: 莱恩：沃尔夫驾驭不了这种力量。一旦贝利亚苏醒，我们所有人都要倒大霉。

speaker: none
english: Rayne: Wulf.  Remember, five years ago in Louisiana?  You almost killed me.
chinese: 莱恩：沃尔夫，还记得五年前的路易斯安那吗？你差点杀了我。

speaker: none
english: Rayne: I intend to pay you back...
chinese: 莱恩：这笔账我会还给你……

speaker: SoldierIntro0
english: Guard: Papers.  Let me see your papers.
chinese: 守卫：证件，把证件拿出来。

speaker: none
english: Rayne: Thanks for the ride, fucko.
chinese: 莱恩：谢了，蠢货，顺风车不错。

english: Rayne: The sun hasn't set yet.  I'm going to get more than sunburned if I stay in the open.
chinese: 莱恩：太阳还没下山。再待在外面，我可就不只是晒伤那么简单了。

speaker: MGNestSoldier1
english: Soldier 1: When did you get here?

speaker: MGNestSoldier2
english: Soldier 2: When did I get where?
chinese: 士兵2：我什么时候到哪儿了？

speaker: MGNestSoldier1
english: Soldier 1: I didn't mean here.  I can see that you just got here.  I meant this outfit.
chinese: 士兵1：我不是说这个，我当然看得出你刚到。我是问你什么时候调到这支部队的。

speaker: MGNestSoldier2
english: Soldier 2: I thought I just told you.
chinese: 士兵2：我刚才不是说了吗？

speaker: MGNestSoldier1
english: Soldier 1: Don't get on my last nerve.  So you're a rookie?
chinese: 士兵1：别挑战我的耐心，所以你是新兵？

speaker: NaziOfficer1
english: Officer: I almost prefer an attack by the vampires than listen to this conversation.
chinese: 军官：我宁愿吸血鬼现在就打过来，也不像听你们俩继续聊下去。

speaker: MGNestSoldier1
english: Soldier 1: You'll get your wish soon enough.  It's almost night.
chinese: 士兵1：很快就能如愿了，马上就天黑了。

speaker: NaziOfficer1
english: Officer: As long as they don't yap endlessly we'll get along.
chinese: 军官：只要它们别没完没了地废话，我跟它们应该处得来。

chinese: 赫德罗克斯：……贝利亚之心。

speaker: Hedrox1
english: Hedrox: Hedrox thought the previous owner, Count Voicu...
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：赫德罗克斯以为上一任主人沃伊库伯爵……

speaker: Hedrox3
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：……把遗物藏了起来。

speaker: Hedrox2
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：赫德罗克斯在这里找到了沃伊库……

speaker: Hedrox1
english: Hedrox: ...and threw him to his death.
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：……把他扔下去摔死了。

speaker: Hedrox2
english: Hedrox: You saw Hedrox eat the human's mind...
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：你看见赫德罗克斯吃掉了那个人类的脑子……

speaker: Hedrox3
english: Hedrox: ...and Hedrox learned Voicu wore the relic on his crown...
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：……赫德罗克斯才知道，沃伊库一直把遗物戴在王冠上……

speaker: Hedrox1
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：……从头到尾都是。

speaker: Hedrox1
english: Hedrox: The human, Jurgen Wulf, is much more than human...
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：那个人类，尤尔根·沃尔夫，早已不只是人类……

speaker: Hedrox2
english: Hedrox: There are relics in his body.
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：他的身体里有遗物。

speaker: Hedrox1
english: Hedrox: Relics not unlike the one in you, Rayne.
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：和你体内那件很像的遗物，莱恩。

speaker: Hedrox3
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：赫德罗克斯想知道秘密。

speaker: Hedrox2
english: Hedrox: Tell Hedrox, how does Hedrox put the relic in the body?
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：告诉赫德罗克斯，怎样才能把遗物放进身体里？

english: Rayne: Sure.  You have to cut your heart out and replace it with Beliar's.
chinese: 莱恩：当然。先把自己的心挖出来，再换上贝利亚的。

speaker: Hedrox2
english: Hedrox: He he he.  Rayne amuses Hedrox.
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：嘿嘿嘿，莱恩真有意思。

speaker: Hedrox2
english: Hedrox: Do you not think Hedrox has tried?
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：你以为赫德罗克斯没试过？

speaker: Hedrox3
english: Hedrox: Did she hope Hedrox would perish in such an attempt?
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：你是不是盼着赫德罗克斯试的时候死掉？

speaker: Hedrox2
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：莱恩忘了吗？

speaker: Hedrox1
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：赫德罗克斯是无穷无尽的。

speaker: Hedrox2
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：赫德罗克斯要知道秘密！

speaker: Hedrox3
english: Hedrox: Hedrox will tear Rayne's eye out...
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：赫德罗克斯会挖出莱恩的眼睛……

speaker: Hedrox1
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：……再吃掉她的脑子。

speaker: Hedrox2
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：……然后找出秘密。

english: Rayne: Hedrox, I'm going to do the same thing to you that you did to Voicu.
chinese: 莱恩：赫德罗克斯，我会把你对沃伊库做的事，原样奉还给你。

speaker: HedroxF_2
english: Hedrox: You understand the word "infinite," Rayne?
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：你明白“无穷”是什么意思吗，莱恩？

speaker: HedroxF_1
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：我们无穷无尽。

speaker: HedroxF_3
english: Hedrox: Cut us and meet more of us.
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：每砍一次，就会见到更多的我们。

english: Rayne: Know why I love you?  Cause you're smart.
chinese: 莱恩：知道我为什么喜欢你吗？因为你很聪明。

english: Rayne: Ah, but there's lots more where you came from, right?
chinese: 莱恩：不过像你这样的还有一大堆，对吧？

english: Rayne: You wanna call em?  Or, how 'bout you cut some more of yourself right now?
chinese: 莱恩：要不要把它们叫来？或者你现在再把自己多切几块？

english: Rayne: I will kill you over and over until there are none of you left.
chinese: 莱恩：我会一遍又一遍地杀你，直到一个都不剩。

english: Rayne: One, two, twenty, a thousand.  You always equal zero to me, Hedrox.
chinese: 莱恩：一个、两个、二十个、一千个。对我来说，加起来永远都是零，赫德罗克斯。

speaker: HedroxExit0
english: Hedrox: Hedrox doesn't need Rayne.  Hedrox will change someone else's mind...
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：赫德罗克斯不需要莱恩，赫德罗克斯会去给别人换换脑子……

english: Chase Hedrox through the broken wall.
chinese: 穿过破墙，追上赫德罗克斯

english: Get Beliar's heart away from Hedrox and Wulf.
chinese: 从赫德罗克斯和沃尔夫手中夺回贝利亚之心

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: Give me the heart, Hedrox!
chinese: 沃尔夫：把心交给我，赫德罗克斯！

speaker: Hedrox3
english: Hedrox: So glad all are here.
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：大家都到齐了，真好。

speaker: Hedrox3
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：……你把贝利亚的残躯带来了。

speaker: Hedrox2
english: Hedrox: Hedrox now knows the secret.
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：赫德罗克斯现在知道秘密了。

speaker: Hedrox3
english: Hedrox: Here's a present for your collection, Rayne.
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：送你一件收藏品，莱恩。

speaker: Hedrox1
english: Hedrox: He guessed the answer for Hedrox.
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：他替赫德罗克斯猜出了答案。

speaker: Hedrox3
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：贝利亚的黑心。

speaker: Hedrox1
english: Hedrox: The relic is hidden within.
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：圣物就藏在里面。

speaker: Hedrox2
english: Hedrox: Ah! I can feel it.
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：啊！赫德罗克斯感觉到了。

speaker: Hedrox1
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：……比以前强大得多。

speaker: Hedrox2
english: Hedrox: What have you done with Hedrox?
chinese: 赫德罗克斯：你们对赫德罗克斯做了什么？

speaker: Beliar
english: Beliar: There is no more Hedrox.  BELIAR IS BORN!  Again.
chinese: 贝利亚：赫德罗克斯已经不存在了，贝利亚重生了！

speaker: Beliar
english: Beliar: Now...each of you has something that belongs to me.
chinese: 贝利亚：现在……你们每个人身上，都有属于我的东西。

english: Rayne: You're going to have to come and get it.
chinese: 莱恩：那你就自己过来拿。
莱恩：这一刀是替明斯还你的。

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: Pathetic.  Doesn't your dead friend deserve a bit more than that?
chinese: 沃尔夫：真可怜。你那死去的朋友，就只值这一下？

english: Rayne: Oh, I'm not done yet.

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: Oh, I think you are.  But I'm not going to make the same mistake twice.  You won't die as easy as that traitor bitch.  For you, it will be a world of pain.
chinese: 沃尔夫：不，我觉得你已经完了。\n不过我不会再犯同样的错误了，你不会像那个叛徒婊子一样死得那么痛快。\n我要让你尝尽折磨。

english: Rayne: All this talk won't save you.  You're dead.  You just haven't grasped the concept yet.  I'll explain it to you.  In detail.
chinese: 莱恩：说再多也救不了你。\n你已经死了，只是你自己还没意识到，我会慢慢给你讲清楚的。

english: Rayne: Now what the hell do I do with this thing?
chinese: 莱恩：现在这玩意儿该怎么处理？

english: Rayne: If the heart is the source of Beliar's power, that's what I need to hit.
chinese: 莱恩：既然心脏是贝利亚力量的源头，那就打它。

english: Beliar's ribs won't protect you from all of my attacks forever, Wulf!
chinese: 沃尔夫，贝利亚的肋骨不可能永远挡住我所有的攻击！

english: Looks like you're not invincible after all, Wulf.
chinese: 看来你也不是刀枪不入嘛，沃尔夫。

english: You should've found more of Beliar's ribs if you had wanted to live.
chinese: 早知道想活命，你就该多找几根贝利亚的肋骨。
前往其他区域搜寻目标

english: G.G.G - Major General D. Traugott: Eliminated
chinese: 反幽灵小组 - D·特劳戈特少将：已消灭

english: Rayne: Why didn't Wulf kill me when he had the chance?
chinese: 莱恩：沃尔夫当时明明有机会，为什么没杀我？

english: Hunt down and kill Jurgen Wulf.
chinese: 追上并杀死尤尔根·沃尔夫

english: Rayne: The "Doppelganger Twins".  What a pleasant surprise.  Such handsome Nazis.  And two of them!
chinese: 莱恩：“镜像双子”，真是惊喜。两个英俊的纳粹，还一模一样！

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: We had no idea the troublemaker...
chinese: 西格蒙德：没想到那个惹麻烦的……

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: ...would be as beautiful as you are.
Rayne: And gentlemanly.  My luck is turning.
chinese: 莱恩：还挺有礼貌，看来我开始走运了。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: What is your name, Fraulein?
chinese: 西格蒙德：小姐，请问芳名？

english: Rayne: Why bother with names?  This won't be more than a one night stand.
chinese: 莱恩：何必问名字？反正我们也就一夜的缘分。

speaker: Sigmund
chinese: 西格蒙德：啊……那可真遗憾。

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: A shame really.  We were hoping for...
chinese: 西蒙：确实可惜，我们原本还希望……

speaker: Sigmund
chinese: 西格蒙德：……能跟你长久一点。

english: Rayne: You know, you two remind me of someone.
chinese: 莱恩：知道吗，你们俩让我想起了一个人。

english: Rayne: Wouldn't go that far.  Just someone I killed...again and again.
chinese: 莱恩：倒也没那么喜欢，只是一个被我杀了一遍又一遍的家伙。

speaker: Simon
chinese: 西蒙：她说的是赫德罗克斯。

english: Rayne: So, you boys lose your arms playing catch?
chinese: 莱恩：怎么，你们俩玩接球，把胳膊玩丢了？

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: No, we were born conjoined...
chinese: 西蒙：不，我们出生时连在一起……

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: ...but sadly, separated soon after birth.
chinese: 西格蒙德：……可惜没多久就被分开了。

english: Rayne: Well when I'm done, you'll be both be missing more than an arm.
chinese: 莱恩：等我收拾完，你们缺的可就不止一条胳膊了。

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: We don't miss an arm...
chinese: 西蒙：我们并不怀念那条胳膊……

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: ...we miss the connection we once had.
chinese: 西格蒙德：……我们怀念的是彼此相连的感觉。

english: Rayne: You boys are too much.  Now this might hurt a little.
chinese: 莱恩：你们俩可真够黏糊的，接下来可能会有点疼。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: You should stop this nonsense...
Rayne: Are you talking about what I think you're talking about?
chinese: 莱恩：你们说的“加入”，不会正是我想的那个意思吧？

speaker: Sigmund
chinese: 西格蒙德：跟我想的一样。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: I don't think she enjoys our company as much as we do hers, brother.
chinese: 西格蒙德：弟弟，她好像没我们这么享受这场约会。

english: Rayne: Oh, I'm really enjoying our little banter.  But that doesn't mean I'm not gonna kill you.
chinese: 莱恩：我确实挺享受跟你们斗嘴的，不过我还是会杀了你们。

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: I just love the crinkle above her nose when she gets angry.
chinese: 西蒙：她生气时鼻梁上那道褶子，我真是喜欢极了。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: There must be an easier way for us to resolve this.
chinese: 西格蒙德：我们应该有更轻松的解决办法。

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: Give in to us, meine liebe.
chinese: 西蒙：从了我们吧，亲爱的。

english: Rayne: I like you guys, so I'll give you a choice.  Who wants to be the first to die?
chinese: 莱恩：我挺喜欢你们的，所以让你们自己选，谁先死？

english: Rayne: You ever feel there's just one of you too many?  I can help you with that.
chinese: 莱恩：你们有没有觉得，两个人有点多余了？我可以帮你们解决。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: Coming from you they're almost pleasurable.
chinese: 西格蒙德：从你嘴里说出来，威胁都显得那么悦耳。

speaker: Simon
chinese: 西蒙：威胁、威胁、还是威胁……

speaker: Sigmund
chinese: 西格蒙德：这一招真漂亮，小姑娘。

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: Oh look!  We surprised her, brother.
chinese: 西蒙：你看，哥哥，她被我们吓到了。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: What a becoming look on her face.
chinese: 西格蒙德：她这副表情可真好看。

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: Oh tell her Sigmund.  She should know.
chinese: 西蒙：告诉她吧，西格蒙德，她有权知道。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: As with everything else, we share the other's pain.
chinese: 西格蒙德：和其他一切一样，我们也会感受到对方的痛苦。

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: One of us is unaffected, while the other suffers.
chinese: 西蒙：一个人毫发无伤，另一个人却会承受伤害。

english: Rayne: So you punch yourself when you're mad at your brother?
chinese: 莱恩：所以你生你兄弟的气，就揍自己一拳？

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: She's so quick.  We should keep her.
chinese: 西蒙：她脑子转得真快，我们应该把她留下。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: We really hate to have to hurt you pretty girl.
chinese: 西格蒙德：漂亮姑娘，我们实在不愿意伤你。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: No need to fight anymore, little girl.
chinese: 西格蒙德：不用再打了，小姑娘。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: You have mortally wounded my brother.  I will follow soon.
chinese: 西格蒙德：你重伤了我的弟弟，我也很快会跟他一起走。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: No, she got me.  I'm sorry brother.
chinese: 西格蒙德：不，她伤的是我。对不起，弟弟。

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: I...I...can't see.  Where are you, Sigmund?
chinese: 西蒙：我……我看不见了。你在哪儿，西格蒙德？

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: I'm here.  I'm here with you.
chinese: 西格蒙德：我在这里，我陪着你。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: You never told us your name...
chinese: 西格蒙德：你还没告诉我们你的名字……

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: I will not fight you anymore.

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: My brother has been mortally wounded. I will follow soon.
chinese: 西蒙：我的哥哥受了致命伤，我很快也会跟他一起走。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: She's better than us, brother.
chinese: 西格蒙德：她比我们强，弟弟。

speaker: Sigmund
english: Sigmund: She is pretty, is she not?
chinese: 西格蒙德：她很漂亮，对吧？

speaker: Simon
english: Simon: My brother would like to know your name.
chinese: 西蒙：我哥哥想知道你的名字。

speaker: Sigmund
chinese: 西格蒙德：她一直没告诉我……

speaker: Simon
chinese: 西蒙：西格蒙德，我的……哥哥。

english: Rayne: You know, your whole coming-back-from-the-dead act is really starting to get old, Mynce.
chinese: 莱恩：明斯，你这套死而复生的把戏，我都快看腻了。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: I'm not doing this on purpose.
Rayne: Listen, do you want to help me or kill me?  Make up your mind!
chinese: 莱恩：你到底是想帮我，还是想杀我？给个准话！

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: I'm sorry.  But Wulf was watching us. I couldn't blow my cover.
chinese: 明斯：对不起。沃尔夫一直盯着我们，我不能暴露身份。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Rayne.  I'm a double agent - ever since that mission in Louisiana.
chinese: 明斯：莱恩，我是双面间谍，从路易斯安那那次任务起就是。

english: Rayne: You expect me to swallow that?

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Yes I do.  Who do you think saved you after Wulf left you for dead in Louisiana?
chinese: 明斯：你必须信。在路易斯安那，沃尔夫把你扔下等死后，是谁救了你？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Who do you think led you to the target file in Germany?
chinese: 明斯：在德国，又是谁把你引到目标名单那里？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Who do you think has been your informant this entire time?
chinese: 明斯：一直给你们提供情报的人，你以为是谁？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: You can check them off your list.  Maybe now you believe me.
chinese: 明斯：可以把他们从名单上划掉了，现在总该信我了吧。

english: Rayne: All right.  Maybe I don't have a choice.
chinese: 莱恩：好吧，看来我也只能信你了。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Don't do me any favors.
Rayne: So why haven't you killed Wulf yet?
chinese: 莱恩：那你为什么还没杀掉沃尔夫？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: It's not that easy.  He's almost invincible with all the relics in his body.
chinese: 明斯：没那么容易。他体内有那么多圣物，几乎已经无敌了。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: He has the ribs from Louisiana, an eye like yours, a hand, and teeth.
chinese: 明斯：他有从路易斯安那得到的肋骨、和你一样的一只眼睛，还有一只手和牙齿。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: But we can't let him get Beliar's heart.  It's the most dangerous piece.
chinese: 明斯：但绝不能让他拿到贝利亚之心，那是最危险的部分。
莱恩：赫德罗克斯已经拿到了 -

english: Rayne: I don't think he knows how to use it though.  He's looking for officers to "interrogate".
chinese: 莱恩：不过他好像还不知道怎么用，他正在找军官“审问”。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: I thought the relic was automatic.
chinese: 明斯：我还以为圣物会自动生效。

english: Rayne: I did too.  But nothing happened.
chinese: 莱恩：我也这么以为，但什么都没发生。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: We need to get that thing away from him and Wulf.  The heart can awaken the demon himself, and we can't let that happen.
chinese: 明斯：我们得赶在沃尔夫前面，从赫德罗克斯手里抢走它。\n那颗心能唤醒贝利亚，绝不能让这种事发生。

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: No one crosses me, ever.  Especially not a bastard vampire.  I am Jurgen Wulf.
chinese: 沃尔夫：从来没人能背叛我，尤其是你这种杂种吸血鬼，我可是尤尔根·沃尔夫。

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: And I will soon hold the heart of Beliar and become immortal.  I will be God.
chinese: 沃尔夫：我很快就会得到贝利亚之心，获得永生。我将成为神！

speaker: Wulf
chinese: 沃尔夫：多么强烈的仇恨，多么浓烈的恐惧。

english: Rayne: I'm going to make you pay for this.  You hear me?  You'll pay for this!
chinese: 莱恩：我会让你付出代价的！听见没有？我一定会让你付出代价！

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: Yes!  Let the rage burn, Rayne.  Feed it.
chinese: 沃尔夫：对！让怒火燃烧吧，莱恩，让它越烧越旺。

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: Why do you think I haven't killed you yet?
chinese: 沃尔夫：你以为我为什么一直没杀你？

english: Rayne: That's gonna be your biggest mistake you son of a bitch!
chinese: 莱恩：那会是你这辈子犯过最大的错，狗杂种！

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: Hedrox waits in the cathedral.  You will join us?
chinese: 沃尔夫：赫德罗克斯正在大教堂等着呢，你也要来吗？

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: You both have something I want.
chinese: 沃尔夫：你们两个身上，都有我想要的东西。

english: Rayne: I'll kill you, Wulf!  Do you hear me?  I'll pull you to pieces!
chinese: 莱恩：我会杀了你，沃尔夫！听见没有？我要把你撕成碎片！

english: Rayne: Mynce!  Oh Jesus Mynce.  Please tell me you're somehow faking this.
chinese: 莱恩：明斯！老天。明斯，求求你告诉我，这次也是装出来的。

english: Rayne: You aren't coming back this time, are you?
chinese: 莱恩：这次你不会再回来了，对吗？

english: Rayne: I'll make him pay.  I promise.  Today, Jurgen Wulf will die.
chinese: 莱恩：我发誓我会让他偿命的。今天，尤尔根·沃尔夫必死。

english: Find and destroy the nest. Find any survivors.
chinese: 摧毁巢穴并寻找幸存者

english: Find the power supply for the elevator.
Rayne: It won't open from this side.

chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里还没处理完。

speaker: Kristin
chinese: 克里斯汀：谁来救救我们！

english: Rayne: Run to the Famille Termaine mausoleum.
chinese: 莱恩：跑去特梅恩家族陵墓。

speaker: Kristin
chinese: 克里斯汀：为什么！？为什么！？

english: Rayne: Damn. It had to be in a flooded basement, didn't it?
chinese: 莱恩：该死，偏偏是在被水淹的地下室里。

english: Rayne: The battery's dead.  I need another one.
chinese: 莱恩：电池没电了，得另找一个。

english: Rayne: I bet the car in the garage has one.
chinese: 莱恩：车库里的汽车应该有一块。

english: Rayne: That doesn't matter.  Go to the Famille Termaine mausoleum as quickly as possible.
chinese: 莱恩：这不重要，赶紧去特梅恩家族陵墓。

english: Follow the aura to the source.
Rayne: It won't open from this side.

chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里还没处理完。

english: Rayne: Mother of God!  What is that!?
chinese: 莱恩：我的天！那是什么东西！？

english: Rayne: Only one way to find out.
Rayne: It won't open from this side.

chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里还没处理完。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: What are you doing Rayne!?

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: You've got work to do.  Go!

speaker: Mynce
chinese: 明斯：当心点，那可是你亲戚。

speaker: Hero_Airboat
english: Rayne: They should have more sense.
chinese: 莱恩：它们要是懂事，就该离我远点。

speaker: Mynce
chinese: 明斯：欢迎来到路易斯安那，莱恩。

speaker: Hero_Airboat
english: Rayne: Thanks for dragging me out here.  I just love the water.
chinese: 莱恩：谢谢你把我拖到这种鬼地方，我最喜欢水了。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: You're only half-vampire.  A dip might hurt, but it won't kill you.
chinese: 明斯：你只有一半的吸血鬼血统，下水会疼，但还不至于要命。

speaker: Hero_Airboat
english: Rayne: So does sticking a finger in my eye.  Doesn't mean I have to do it.
chinese: 莱恩：拿手指戳眼睛也不会死，也不代表我乐意这么干啊。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: No time for pleasantries.  Just like your half-sister.
chinese: 明斯：连句客套话都没有，跟你同父异母的姐姐一个样。

speaker: Hero_Airboat
english: Rayne: Yeah, it's a family trait.  I'd just like to walk on my own two feet someday.
chinese: 莱恩：是啊，家族遗传，我只希望有一天能自己做主。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: You will.  I'm only here to make sure your cockiness doesn't get you killed.  That's all.
chinese: 明斯：会有那一天的。我来只是为了防止你因为太自负而送命，仅此而已。

speaker: Hero_Airboat
english: Rayne: I'm just confident in my abilities.
chinese: 莱恩：我只是对自己的本事有信心。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: So am I.  But this is your first assignment for the Brimstone Society, so everything must go according to plan.
chinese: 明斯：我也相信你。但这是你加入硫磺会后的第一次任务，绝不能出岔子。

speaker: Hero_Airboat
english: Rayne: Or make sure I don't try to kill my vampire father again.
chinese: 莱恩：或者说，你是来盯着我，免得我再去杀那个吸血鬼老爹。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: If needed.  And prepare you.
chinese: 明斯：必要的话，没错，这也是为了让你做好准备。

speaker: Hero_Airboat
english: Rayne: I suppose you want me to go over the mission again?
chinese: 莱恩：你是想让我再复述一遍任务吧？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: What do we know so far?
chinese: 明斯：目前我们知道什么？

speaker: Hero_Airboat
english: Rayne: The Earth is round and rotates around the sun...
chinese: 莱恩：地球是圆的，而且绕着太阳转……

speaker: Hero_Airboat
english: Rayne: Fine.  Newspapers claim the people of Mortton, Louisiana are turning into some type of monster.  They're calling them 'Mutates'.  Doctors think a new disease is the cause, so they've quarantined the area.
chinese: 莱恩：行吧。\n报纸说路易斯安那州莫顿的居民正在变成某种怪物，人们管他们叫“变异体”。\n医生认为是某种新疾病造成的，所以已经封锁了这里。

speaker: Hero_Airboat
english: Rayne: There are numerous known biological masses in town.  They appear to be the 'carriers' of the condition.
chinese: 莱恩：镇上已知有多处生物组织块，看起来就是这种病的“传染源”。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: And that's where you come in.  Destroy the sources of the infection.  And as many of the infected townspeople as possible.  The disease cannot spread beyond this village.
chinese: 明斯：这就轮到你出场了。\n摧毁传染源，尽量消灭已经感染的镇民，绝不能让这种病传出村子。

speaker: Hero_Airboat
english: Rayne: Sort of a radical cure, don't you think?
chinese: 莱恩：这治法是不是有点太狠了？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: You'll be doing them a favor.  In the final stages their brains liquify and run out their nose and ears.
chinese: 明斯：你这是在帮他们解脱。\n到了晚期，他们的脑子会化成液体，从鼻子和耳朵里流出来。

speaker: Hero_Airboat
chinese: 莱恩：这感冒可真够厉害的。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Oh, you've seen it all, haven't you?
chinese: 明斯：呵，你还真是见多识广啊。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: One of the biological masses was found at the end of this road, in a graveyard behind the church.  We'll meet up there.
chinese: 明斯：有人在这条路尽头发现了一处生物组织块，就在教堂后面的墓地里。\n我们在那里会合。

english: Use @@moveAxis@@ to move BloodRayne forward and backward. @@turnAxis@@ turns.  @@pointAxis@@ looks up and down.
chinese: 使用@@moveAxis@@控制莱恩前后移动，使用@@turnAxis@@转向，使用@@pointAxis@@上下观察
使用@@turnAxis@@转向，使用@@pointAxis@@上下观察

english: Adjust the sensitivity of turning/looking in the control options menu by pressing @@startButtonName@@
chinese: 按@@startButtonName@@打开控制选项菜单，可调整转向与视角的灵敏度

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: What's that mound by the telephone pole?
chinese: 明斯：电话杆旁边那堆东西是什么？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: It is...was...human.  Might be remains from the final stages of the disease, but there's something not quite right about it.
chinese: 明斯：它是……曾经是个人，可能是病情晚期留下的残骸，但看起来有点不对劲。

english: Rayne: Good thing we're not hypersensitive to holy items like some vampires.
chinese: 莱恩：幸好我们不像某些吸血鬼那样，一碰圣物就受不了。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Hmmm, seems like somebody made their last stand here.  Grab some guns if you want.
chinese: 明斯：嗯……看来有人在这里负隅顽抗过，想拿枪的话就拿吧。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: You should be all set.  I'm going to leaf through these documents.  Maybe I can find something about past outbreaks of the disease.
chinese: 明斯：装备应该够了。我去翻翻这些文件，也许能找到以前暴发这种疾病的记录。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: That wall stretches across the whole town.  Thirty feet high.
chinese: 明斯：那堵墙横贯整个镇子，足有三十英尺高。

english: Rayne: I can see that.  So?
chinese: 莱恩：这我看得出来，所以呢？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: I found a book that said in 1903 the "old town" was completely evacuated.  No one has been on the other side of that wall ever since.
chinese: 明斯：我在一本书里看到，1903年“旧城区”被彻底疏散。\n从那以后，再没人去过围墙另一边。

english: Rayne: I don't think I follow.

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: I found another book.  It was very old, and some of it was written in an antiquated dialect.
chinese: 明斯：我还找到另一本书，年代非常久远，其中一些内容用的是古老方言。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: From what I understood, even the earliest French settlers feared something in these swamps.
chinese: 明斯：照我的理解，最早来到这里的法国移民，就已经在害怕沼泽里的某种东西了。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: "After our dark year, in 1873 the first stone of this great Wall of Fortitude was laid."
chinese: 明斯：“黑暗之年过后，公元1873年，这座宏伟的坚毅之墙奠下了第一块基石。”

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: "With this plaque mounted in the year 1888 of our Lord, construction is complete."
chinese: 明斯：“此碑立于主历1888年，工程至此竣工。”

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: "May this Wall of Fortitude, with the grace of God, shield us from evil and keep us safe now and forever."
chinese: 明斯：“愿坚毅之墙蒙受上帝恩典，抵御邪恶，护佑吾等从今直至永远。”

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Something tells me they didn't build that wall to keep out a disease.
chinese: 明斯：我有种感觉，他们修这堵墙可不是为了挡住疾病。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: I'm going to see what else I can find in those books.
chinese: 明斯：我再去看看那些书里还有什么。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: You should take out those bio-masses.  The first one's in the graveyard.  I'll meet up with you later.
chinese: 明斯：你去摧毁那些生物组织块，第一个就在墓地里，之后再会合。

english: Rayne: Seems like they built that wall for nothing.
chinese: 莱恩：看来这堵墙算是白修了。

english: Find and destroy the nest. Find any survivors.
chinese: 摧毁巢穴并寻找幸存者

english: Rayne: It won't open from this side.

chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里还没处理完。

english: Rayne: Flooded. Why can it never be easy?
chinese: 莱恩：又被水淹了，就不能有一次是省点事的吗？

speaker: Deputy
english: Deputy: Hiyah! Die you ugly son o'bitch!
chinese: 副警长：呀！去死吧，你这丑八怪！

english: Rayne: Easy with that thing.  And who'd you call ugly?
chinese: 莱恩：小心点，还有，你说谁丑呢？

speaker: Deputy
english: Deputy: Excuse moi.  I, ahhh...I didn't mean to...
chinese: 副警长：对不起，我……我不是说你……

english: Rayne: Save it.  Just go to Famille Termaine mausoleum.  You'll be safe there.
chinese: 莱恩：少废话，去特梅恩家族陵墓，那里是安全的。

speaker: Deputy
english: Deputy: Well I don' t'ink so, you see, I got it pretty good right here, ya.  All the guns I need and...
chinese: 副警长：这个嘛，我觉得没必要吧。\n你看，我在这儿挺好的，枪要多少有多少，而且……

english: Rayne: ...and it's only a matter of time before these things find a way in.  I did.  And what if your ammo runs out?
chinese: 莱恩：……而且那些怪物迟早会闯进来。我不就进来了吗？等子弹打光了怎么办？

speaker: Deputy
english: Deputy: Well...maybe you got a point, but...
chinese: 副警长：嗯……你说得也有道理，可是……

english: Rayne: Take your gun and go.  The gravedigger's already there.  It's the safest place for now.
chinese: 莱恩：带上枪，快走。掘墓人已经在那里了，目前那是最安全的地方。

speaker: Deputy
english: Deputy: Gravedigger?  Jean's alive?  My brother in-law?  A'right, I go.
chinese: 副警长：掘墓人？让还活着？我那个姐夫？好吧，我这就走。

speaker: Deputy
english: Deputy: Excuse my manners.  Adieu mademoiselle.
chinese: 副警长：刚才失礼了。再见，小姐。

speaker: Deputy
english: Deputy: That'd be Deputy Gorham, cher.
chinese: 副警长：我叫戈勒姆，是这里的副警长，亲爱的。

english: Rayne: Deputy Gorham then, how about unlocking this thing?
chinese: 莱恩：那么戈勒姆副警长，能不能先帮我把这东西打开？

speaker: Deputy
english: Deputy: Say fin'.  Well I'm off now.  Later, mon' cher.
chinese: 副警长：搞定。那我先走了，回头见，亲爱的。

english: Rayne: I can't carry them all.  I can always come back.
chinese: 莱恩：我一次拿不了这么多，可以以后再回来。

speaker: BigMan
english: BigMan: Damn.  I shot my own damn foot.
chinese: 壮汉：该死，我一枪打中了自己的脚。

speaker: BigMan
english: BigMan: I'm fine, I'm fine.  I done it before.  Twice.
chinese: 壮汉：没事，没事。我以前也干过这种事，两次。

english: Rayne: Maybe you should give me that gun.
chinese: 莱恩：我看你还是把枪交给我吧。

speaker: BigMan
english: BigMan: Yeah ok, but what about me?

speaker: BigMan
english: BigMan: Hell, I can run if I want.  Ain't got no feeling in my foot anyway.
chinese: 壮汉：废话，我想跑都行，反正这只脚早就没知觉了。

english: Rayne: Then go to Famille Termaine mausoleum and hide out there.
chinese: 莱恩：那就去特梅恩家族陵墓躲起来。

speaker: BigMan
english: BigMan: Wit' dem dead bodies?  I can't even stand de smell!
chinese: 壮汉：跟一堆死人待在一起？那味儿我可受不了！

english: Rayne: It's no rose garden here either.  Now move it.
chinese: 莱恩：你这里也没香到哪儿去，快走。

speaker: BigMan
english: BigMan: You sorry rascal, you ain't never gonna kill...aahhh.
chinese: 壮汉：你这个狗东西，别想杀了……啊！

english: Find and destroy the nest. Find any survivors.
chinese: 摧毁巢穴并寻找幸存者

english: Rebound kick can be used to break down weak spots in walls.
chinese: 反弹踢可破坏墙壁的薄弱处

english: Rayne: It won't open from this side.

chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里还没处理完。

english: Rayne: Go to the Famille Termaine mausoleum.  You'll be safe there.
chinese: 莱恩：去特梅恩家族陵墓，那里安全。

speaker: MaleSurvivor
english: Survivor: Anyt'ing you say.  Just don' kill me.  Merci.
chinese: 幸存者：你说什么我都照做，只求你别杀我，谢谢。

speaker: MaleSurvivor
english: Survivor: I thank you.  Merci.  Please check on my frien' Claude Latrelle!  He's 'oled up wit a shotgun over there...
chinese: 幸存者：谢谢你，真的谢谢你。\n求你去看看我的朋友克劳德·拉特雷尔！他拿着霰弹枪躲在那边……

english: Rayne: Get moving!  I'll see what I can do.
chinese: 莱恩：快走！我去看看还能做什么。
莱恩：看来克劳德已经没救了。

english: Rayne: This is going to hurt a little.
Rayne: Run to Famille Termain mausoleum. You'll be safe there.
chinese: 莱恩：快跑去特梅恩家族陵墓，那里安全。

speaker: Kazi
english: Kazi: Tank you.  No pleasure lookin' at insides.
chinese: 卡兹：谢谢你。看见自己的肚子里面，一点也不好玩。

speaker: Kazi
english: Kazi: Dat bitch Marassa.  I git me hands on her, I make her eat her magic.
chinese: 卡兹：玛拉莎那个婊子，等我抓到她，我让她把自己的妖术吃下去。

speaker: Kazi
english: Kazi: Marassa.  Fancies 'erself Marie Laveau, Voodoo priestess.
chinese: 卡兹：玛拉莎，她真把自己当成巫毒女祭司玛丽·拉沃了。

speaker: Kazi
english: Kazi: She hook up wit dee old German who came 'ere.  She go out to boat graveyard an' she do black magic.
chinese: 卡兹：她跟那个来这里的德国老头混在一起，跑到船舶墓地施黑魔法。
莱恩：这里的一切都是她干的？

speaker: Kazi
english: Kazi: Oui!  She and dee German.  Scary man.  Evil.
chinese: 卡兹：对！她和那个德国人。那人很可怕，邪恶得很。

speaker: Kazi
english: Kazi: She said she goin' out dere to raise the mother of dee underworld!
chinese: 卡兹：她说要去那里唤醒冥界之母！

english: Rayne: Must be one attractive lady.  You better get going to Famille Termaine mausoleum.  It's the only safe place in town.
chinese: 莱恩：听起来一定是位大美人。\n你最好赶紧去特梅恩家族陵墓，那是镇上唯一安全的地方。

speaker: KAZI
english: Kazi: Marassa.  Voodoo priestess.  Hah!  Five cent magic.  I show you.  I make you look at insides.
chinese: 卡兹：玛拉莎，巫毒女祭司，哈！廉价的把戏。\n等着瞧吧，我也要让你看看自己的肚子里面。

english: Rayne: It won't open from this side.

chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里还没处理完。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: What are you doing Rayne!?
Rayne: What the?  Is that the bio-mass?
chinese: 莱恩：搞什么？那就是生物组织块？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Well done.  Strange creatures, aren't they?
chinese: 明斯：干得不错。这些生物很奇怪，对吧？

english: Rayne: Strange isn't the first word that comes to mind.  What are they?
chinese: 莱恩：我首先能想到的词可不是“奇怪”，它们到底是什么？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: I'm not sure.  But it seems they carry a disease that causes mutations in humans.
chinese: 明斯：我也不确定。不过它们似乎携带着一种疾病，会让人类发生变异。
莱恩：所以才有那些变异体。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Right, and remember those sludge mounds we've been finding everywhere?
chinese: 明斯：没错，还记得我们到处看到的那些烂泥堆吗？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Humans.  What's left of them.  The spider creatures regurgitate what they eat.
chinese: 明斯：那是人类，或者说他们剩下的东西，那些蜘蛛怪会把吃下去的东西吐出来。

english: Rayne: Strange doesn't even begin to cover it.
chinese: 莱恩：光说“奇怪”都有点太客气了。

speaker: Gravedigger
english: Gravedigger: Ahh!  Please, is somebody d'ere!?
chinese: 掘墓人：啊！求求你，外面有人吗！？

speaker: Gravedigger
chinese: 掘墓人：那些马雷斯克走了吗？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: The Maraisreq.  "Swamp monster".  That's what the Creole call the creatures.
chinese: 明斯：马雷斯克，意思是“沼泽怪物”，克里奥尔人就是这么称呼这些生物的。

speaker: Gravedigger
chinese: 掘墓人：它们真的走了吗！？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Yes.  Now open the door.

speaker: Gravedigger
chinese: 掘墓人：我的天，那些恶魔！

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Nice welcome for the rescue team.  Who are you?
chinese: 明斯：这就是你欢迎救命恩人的方式？你是谁？

speaker: Gravedigger
english: Gravedigger: I'm Jean Sigmon.  I'm dee grave digger.
chinese: 掘墓人：我叫让·西格蒙，是这里的掘墓人。

speaker: Gravedigger
english: Gravedigger: I don' know.  I hid in 'ere when those...when those 'tings came.  Dey can't get in wit'out dem holes.
chinese: 掘墓人：我不知道，那些……那些东西出现时，我就躲进来了。\n这里没洞，它们钻不进来。

english: Rayne: Doesn't seem like he's infected.
chinese: 莱恩：他看起来没被感染。

speaker: Gravedigger
english: Gravedigger: Some of us didn't catch it.
chinese: 掘墓人：我们中有些人没有染上。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: If that's the case, there might be other survivors.
chinese: 明斯：那就说明可能还有其他幸存者。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Jean, you stay put.  This place is obviously safe.  We'll bring other survivors here.
chinese: 明斯：让，你留在这里，这里看起来很安全，我们会把其他幸存者带过来。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Not yet.  You'll be safe here for a while longer.
chinese: 明斯：暂时不走，你在这里还能安全一阵子。

speaker: Gravedigger
english: Gravedigger: Okay.  Okay.  Send 'dem here to Famille Termaine mausoleum and we wait.
chinese: 掘墓人：好，好，让他们都来特梅恩家族陵墓，我们在这里等。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: If you find anyone that is healthy and alive, send them here.  But don't forget about the nests.
chinese: 明斯：找到健康的幸存者，就让他们来这里，不过别忘了摧毁巢穴。

english: Rayne: Seems like they built that wall for nothing.
chinese: 莱恩：看来那堵墙算是白修了。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Maybe.  Or maybe this time around things got worse.  These creatures are very insect-like.  Seems every thirty years they swarm.
chinese: 明斯：也许吧，也可能是这一次的情况更糟。\n这些生物很像是昆虫，似乎每隔三十年就会成群出现。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Only this one's different.  More dangerous.  We can't let them spread any further.
chinese: 明斯：但这次不同，也更加危险，绝不能让它们继续扩散。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: I sketched out a map of approximate locations.  The reports weren't exact, so you'll have to search the area thoroughly.
chinese: 明斯：我根据报告大致标出了位置，不过报告并不准确，你得把附近仔细搜一遍。

english: Press @@startButtonName@@ and select Map of Mortton to view the map/objectives at any time.
chinese: 按@@startButtonName@@并选择“莫顿地图”，可随时查看地图和任务目标

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Once you're back we'll head over that wall.  There must be some type of source where all these creatures come from.
chinese: 明斯：等你回来以后，我们就翻过那堵墙，这些生物肯定有一个共同的源头。

speaker: Mynce
chinese: 明斯：也许吧，或者是更大的东西。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: I almost forgot.  I have something for you.
chinese: 明斯：差点忘了，我有东西要给你。

english: Hit bite button @@harpoonbitebuttonname@@ when far from a target to throw out a harpoon.
chinese: 距离目标较远时按@@harpoonbitebuttonname@@，可射出鱼叉

english: Then hold the bite button @@harpoonbitebuttonname@@ and the harpoon will reel in the victim if they were caught off guard, scared, or wounded.
chinese: 命中措手不及、受到惊吓或负伤的敌人后，按住@@harpoonbitebuttonname@@可将其拖到身边

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: It's essentially a harpoon.  It helps with feeding and has a decent range.
chinese: 明斯：其实就是一把鱼叉，既方便你吸血，射程也不错。

english: Then tap the bite button @@harpoonbitebuttonname@@ to feed.
chinese: 然后轻按吸血键@@harpoonbitebuttonname@@开始吸血

english: Press @@jumpbuttonname@@ to quit feeding early and dismount.
chinese: 按@@jumpbuttonname@@可提前停止吸血并跳下

english: Do not hold the bite button if you wish to use the harpoon as a damaging knife attack.
chinese: 使用鱼叉进行伤害性刀击时，不要按住吸血键

english: While holding in, hit bite button @@harpoonbitebuttonname@@ for harpoon, or the weapon attack button for guns to shoot breakable objects like furniture, barrels, crates, etc.
chinese: 抓住敌人时，按吸血键@@harpoonbitebuttonname@@可使用鱼叉，\n或按武器攻击键开枪射击家具、木桶、箱子等可破坏物体

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: I'll protect the mausoleum.  You go find those nests.
chinese: 明斯：我来守住陵墓，你去找那些巢穴。

speaker: Gravedigger
chinese: 掘墓人：是你们两位漂亮小姐吗？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Having fun tormenting our local friend?
chinese: 明斯：折腾我们这位本地朋友很开心吗？

english: Rayne: Beats hunting bugs and hopping through water.
chinese: 莱恩：总比抓虫子、在水里蹦来蹦去有意思。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Need help?  Use your aura vision.  It will guide you to the right area.  Look for the bright aura.  If it's not exact it will at least be very close.
chinese: 明斯：需要帮忙吗？使用灵光视野，它会指引你前往正确区域。\n寻找明亮的灵光，就算位置不完全准确，也不会差太远。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Look in every building.  Look in every room, upstairs and down.  You need to find those nests.
chinese: 明斯：每栋建筑都要搜，每个房间都别漏，上下楼都要检查，你必须找到那些巢穴。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: You have a map.  Check it to get a general idea of where the nests are.
chinese: 明斯：你有地图，可以用它大致确认巢穴的位置。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Some places might be very tricky to get into.  Use your brain and all of your abilities to get into each house.
chinese: 明斯：有些地方可能很难进去。动动脑子，利用你的所有能力进入每栋房子。

english: If you can't find your objective go to aura vision and go toward the bright aura.  If there is no bright aura you are in the right area already.  Look all over.
chinese: 找不到任务目标时，切换至灵光视野并朝明亮的灵光前进。\n若没有明亮的灵光，说明你已经身处正确区域，仔细搜索四周。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: You've got work to do.  Go!

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Ok...you got me.  I'll tell you a secret.  If you press left, left, right, up, down, left, down, up, up, all of our clothes disappear.
chinese: 明斯：好吧……被你发现了。\n我告诉你一个秘密：\n依次按左、左、右、上、下、左、下、上、上，我们俩的衣服就会全部消失。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Not fast enough.  Try again.

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Ha! Ha!  There is no code!  You should see yourself, hopping around like a chicken on a hot plate.  And only to have us naked in a graveyard.
chinese: 明斯：哈哈！根本没有这种秘籍！\n你真该看看自己刚才的样子，活像只在热铁板上乱蹦的鸡。\n就为了让我们俩在墓地里脱光？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Ha! Ha!  There is no code!  You should see yourself, hopping around like a chicken on a hot plate.  And only to have us naked in a graveyard.
chinese: 明斯：哈哈！根本没有这种秘籍！\n你真该看看自己刚才的样子，活像只在热铁板上乱蹦的鸡。\n就为了让我们俩在墓地里脱光？

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Maybe you chose the wrong profession.

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: I can't believe I kept a straight face that whole time!
chinese: 明斯：真不敢相信，我刚才居然一直忍住没笑！

english: Press left, left, right, up, down, left, down, up, up to make BloodRayne and Mynce naked.
chinese: 依次按左、左、右、上、下、左、下、上、上，可让莱恩和明斯脱光衣服。

speaker: Daddy
english: Daddy: You'll pay dear for hurtin' ma family!
chinese: 父亲：敢伤害我的家人，我饶不了你！

speaker: Kazi
english: Kazi: Oh Saint Peter, here we come.
chinese: 卡兹：圣彼得啊，我们这就来了。

speaker: Deputy
english: Deputy: Hiya! To hell with ya, ya ugly sons a bitches!
chinese: 副警长：呀！下地狱吧，你们这群丑八怪！

english: Rayne: Time to put an end to this.  I'll find those bastards and rip their legs off one by one.
chinese: 莱恩：是时候结束这一切了。我要找到那群杂种，把它们的腿一条一条扯下来。

english: Rayne: You hear me you rotten stinking crab legged chicken-shit dirtballs!?  Run!  Because here I come!
chinese: 莱恩：听见没有，你们这群又臭又烂、长着螃蟹腿的胆小鬼！？快逃吧！我来了！

english: Rayne: I will finish this, Mynce.
chinese: 莱恩：我会了结这一切的，明斯。

english: Rayne: It won't open from this side.

chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里还没处理完。

english: Mortton, Louisiana, 1933. Mission briefing: A mysterious plague has devastated the quiet rural village of Mortton.
chinese: 1933年，路易斯安那州莫顿。任务简报：一场神秘瘟疫摧毁了宁静的乡村小镇莫顿。

english: This disease is 100% lethal, causing the brains of the infected to liquify, and seep through facial orifices in a thick, viscous fluid.  Prior to death, some cases mutate into mindless, disfigured monsters.  There is no known cure...
chinese:
这种疾病的致死率为100%，会使感染者的大脑液化，
变成浓稠的黏液，从面部孔窍中渗出，
有些患者在死亡前还会变成失去理智、面目全非的怪物。
目前没有已知疗法……

english: Even more disturbing are the plague's carriers: large insectoid creatures originating from the bayous surrounding Mortton.
chinese: 更令人不安的是瘟疫的传播者：来自莫顿周边沼泽的大型昆虫状生物。

english: BloodRayne, you must find and destroy the nests of the plague carriers before they can reproduce and spread the infestation to neighboring towns.
chinese: 莱恩，\n你必须在这些瘟疫传播者繁殖并将灾害扩散至邻近城镇前，找到并摧毁它们的巢穴。

english: The nests are usually hidden, though because of their large size, they're hard to miss.  Find them and destroy them.
chinese: 巢穴通常藏得很隐蔽，不过体积庞大，很难错过。\n找到并摧毁它们。

english: Follow the Maraisreq to find the source.
chinese: 跟随马雷斯克找到源头

english: Rayne: It won't open from this side.

chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里还没处理完。

english: Rayne: Mother of God!  What is that!?
chinese: 莱恩：我的天！那是什么东西！？

english: Rayne: Only one way to find out.

chinese: 莱恩：瞧瞧是谁在前面乱窜。

english: Rayne: Go ahead.  Lead me to your nest.
chinese: 莱恩：继续跑，带我去你的巢穴。

english: Rayne: Get out of my way!
Rayne: That was smart, Rayne.  You killed it.  Where to now?
chinese: 莱恩：干得漂亮，莱恩。你把它杀了，现在往哪走？

english: Rayne: It won't open from this side.

chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里还没处理完。

english: Rayne: That's as good as it gets.  Looks like I'll have to get my feet wet.
chinese: 莱恩：就这样了，看来非得下水不可了。

english: Mortton, Louisiana, 1933. Mission briefing: A mysterious plague has devastated the quiet rural village of Mortton.
chinese: 1933年，路易斯安那州莫顿。任务简报：一场神秘瘟疫摧毁了宁静的乡村小镇莫顿。

english: This disease is 100% lethal, causing the brains of the infected to liquify, and seep through facial orifices in a thick, viscous fluid.  Prior to death, some cases mutate into mindless, disfigured monsters.  There is no known cure...
chinese:
这种疾病的致死率为100%，会使感染者的大脑液化，
变成浓稠黏液，从面部孔窍中渗出。
有些患者在死亡前还会变成失去理智、面目全非的怪物。
目前没有已知疗法……

english: Even more disturbing are the plague's carriers: large insectoid creatures originating from the bayous surrounding Mortton.
chinese: 更令人不安的是瘟疫的传播者：来自莫顿周边沼泽的大型昆虫状生物。

english: BloodRayne, you must find and destroy the nests of the plague carriers before they can reproduce and spread the infestation to neighboring towns.
chinese: 莱恩，\n你必须在这些瘟疫传播者繁殖并将灾害扩散至邻近城镇前，找到并摧毁它们的巢穴。

english: The nests are usually hidden, though because of their large size, they're hard to miss.  Find them and destroy them.
chinese: 巢穴通常藏得很隐蔽，不过体积庞大，很难错过。\n找到并摧毁它们。

english: Rayne: As good as it gets.  Is there no dry land anymore?
chinese: 莱恩：只能这样了，这里就没有一块干地吗？

english: Rayne: That's the last of 'em.  Time to head back to the graveyard and meet up with Mynce.
chinese: 莱恩：这是最后一个，该回墓地跟明斯会合了。

english: You have gained the ability to perform a Level 3 Bloodrage attack!
chinese: 你已获得施展3级血怒攻击的能力！

english: Rayne: It won't open from this side.

chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里还没处理完。

english: Rayne: The aura's gone. But what's that?
chinese: 莱恩：灵光消失了。可那是什么？

english: Rayne: ...to awaken the "mother of the underworld"?
chinese: 莱恩：……为了唤醒“冥界之母”？

english: Rayne: Either she's a smoker or someone was just here.
chinese: 莱恩：要么她烟瘾很大，要么直到刚才这里还有人。

english: Rayne: Back to sleep for you.
Rayne: Awww...did you eat something that isn't agreeing with your tummy?
chinese: 莱恩：哎呀……是不是吃坏肚子了？

english: Rayne: It burns!  Oh god it burns!

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: I believe you have what I'm looking for.
chinese: 沃尔夫：我想，你身上正好有我要找的东西。

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: You might say I'm a collector of these things.
chinese: 沃尔夫：你可以认为我是这种东西的收藏家。

speaker: Wulf
english: Wulf: Nothing personal, although I will enjoy this greatly.
chinese: 沃尔夫：我无意针对你，不过我会非常享受这个过程。
莱恩：不……控制不住……啊啊啊啊！

english: Rayne: It won't open from this side.

chinese: 莱恩：不行，这里还没处理完。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: What are you doing Rayne!?
BloodRayne automatically "tightropes" when close enough to an appropriate object.
chinese: 莱恩靠近合适的物体时，会自动在上面保持平衡行走。

english: Press Left or Right on D-pad if BloodRayne begins to lose balance.  To turn around perform a quick-turn.
chinese: 若莱恩开始失去平衡时，请按方向键左或右调整；需要转身时，请使用快速转身

english: To avoid obstacles, you may need to jump over them.  Press @@jumpbuttonname@@ to jump.
chinese: 遇到障碍时可能需要跳过去，按@@jumpbuttonname@@跳跃

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Locked.  And the windows are blocked.
chinese: 明斯：锁住了，窗户也被封死了。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Let's hope they didn't barricade the door from the inside.
chinese: 明斯：希望他们没有从里面把门堵上。

english: Rebound kick = Jump @@jumpbuttonname@@, then release and press again near any character or breakable environment piece.
chinese: 反弹踢＝按@@jumpbuttonname@@跳跃，松开后在角色或可破坏场景物体附近再次按下

english: Often a double jump works the best for low objects.
chinese: 面对较低的物体时，二段跳通常效果最好。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: It's blocked from the other side.  But there seems to be a weak spot in the wall.
chinese: 明斯：另一边堵住了，不过墙上似乎有个薄弱点。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Kindly make us a new door, Miss Rayne.  I'd like to investigate.
chinese: 明斯：劳驾给我们开扇新门吧，莱恩小姐。我想进去调查。

english: Rebound kick can be used to break down weak spots in walls.
chinese: 反弹踢可破坏墙壁的薄弱处

english: Perform combos by hitting Blade/Kick @@action1buttonname@@ at the end of each attack.
chinese: 每次攻击结束时按刀刃／踢击键@@action1buttonname@@，可发动连续技
按@@action1buttonname@@发动1级攻击——快速挥砍

english: Press now to trigger level 2 - Spin Kick.
chinese: 现在按下可发动2级攻击 - 回旋踢
莱恩：真爱显摆，杀戮欲望满足了？

english: Attacking enemies fills your Bloodlust meter.  More spectacular attacks fill the meter faster.
chinese: 攻击敌人可填充杀戮欲望槽。攻击越华丽，填充速度越快

speaker: Mynce_StandIn
english: Mynce: ...but more to come.  And there's a volunteer.
chinese: 明斯：……不过后面还有。正好来了个自愿陪练的。

english: Fill your Bloodlust meter to earn a Blood Rage "bomb".
chinese: 填满杀戮欲望槽，可获得一次血怒“爆发”

english: Enter Blood Rage @@bloodragebuttonname@@ to gain a speed advantage, increase dismemberment, and perform new attacks.
chinese: 按@@bloodragebuttonname@@进入血怒状态，可提高速度、增强肢解效果并施展新的攻击

english: Hit @@action1buttonname@@ for level 1 B.R. - Spinning blade.
chinese: 按@@action1buttonname@@发动1级血怒攻击 - 旋转刀刃

english: Press @@action1buttonname@@ now to trigger level 2 Blood Rage - Scissor Kick.
chinese: 现在按@@action1buttonname@@发动2级血怒攻击 - 剪刀腿

english: Press @@visionNormalButtonName@@ to enter normal view and exit Blood Rage early.  This conserves Bloodlust.
chinese: 按@@visionNormalButtonName@@切换至普通视野并提前退出血怒状态，可节省杀戮欲望能量

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Shhh.  There's one.  Use your Aura Sense to see it in the dark.
chinese: 明斯：嘘，那里有一个，用灵光感知在黑暗中看见他。

english: Press @@visionAuraButtonName@@ to enter aura vision.  Aura vision works well as night vision.  But it also shows enemies' health and awareness.
chinese: 按@@visionAuraButtonName@@进入灵光视野。灵光视野可充当夜视功能，也能显示敌人的生命值和警觉程度

english: Normally an enemies' health goes from green to yellow to orange to red.  Green is 100% healthy and aware of BloodRayne.
chinese: 通常敌人的生命状态会依次显示为绿色、黄色、橙色和红色。\n绿色表示生命值为100%，并且已经察觉莱恩

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Easy prey if you want it.
chinese: 明斯：想动手的话，这个很好对付。

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: He's a big meal.  Look how bright his aura is.  He has no idea we're here.
chinese: 明斯：这可是顿大餐。看他的灵光多亮，他完全不知道我们在这里。

english: Rayne: He's not panicking or hurt...yet.
chinese: 莱恩：他现在还没害怕，也没受伤。

english: There are three special instances when an enemy has a red aura. 1: he is caught off guard.  2: he is scared.  3: he is low in health.
chinese: 敌人的灵光会在三种特殊情况下变红：1.毫无防备；2.受到惊吓；3.生命值较低

english: If the aura is red you can gauge the health by the brightness of the glow.  The brighter it is, the healthier the enemy.
chinese: 灵光变红时，可根据亮度判断敌人的生命值；光芒越亮，敌人越健康

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: This one's yours.  Take him down, or grab a bite to eat.
chinese: 明斯：这个归你。干掉他，或者吃上一口。

english: Bite = get close to a victim and tap @@harpoonbitebuttonname@@ quickly.
chinese: 吸血＝靠近目标并快速轻按@@harpoonbitebuttonname@@

english: Steer standing victims to use as a "human shield" = @@turnAxis@@
chinese: 操纵站立的敌人，将其作为“人体盾牌”＝@@turnAxis@@

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: You tell me.  Use your aura sense.
chinese: 明斯：你来告诉我。用灵光感知。

english: If you don't know where to go, use your aura vision (@@visionAuraButtonName@@) and look for a bright glow.
chinese: 不知道该往哪里走时，请使用灵光视野（@@visionAuraButtonName@@）并寻找明亮的光芒

english: This glow is your immediate objective. This glow will even shine through walls.
chinese: 该光芒表示当前任务目标，即使隔着墙壁也能看见

speaker: Mynce
english: Mynce: Guess we're done here.  Let's go to the church.
chinese: 明斯：看来这里已经处理完了，去教堂吧。

english: Weapons with ammo will flash.  These are automatically picked up by walking over them until inventory is full - two large guns, four small guns, two grenades, and one special gun.

english: Rayne: The piles of melted people obviously won't need them anymore.
chinese: 莱恩：那些融成一摊的人显然也用不着了。

chinese: 莱恩：枪还不错，但近身战还是刀刃最好用。

chinese: 莱恩：虽然我已经说过，我根本不需要。

chinese: 明斯：装满子弹的枪是件不错的礼物。\n但战斗时我可不会浪费时间笨手笨脚地换弹匣，打空了就扔掉它。

english: Rayne: I know.  I'm not a pack mule.
chinese: 莱恩：我知道，我又不是驮东西的骡子。

english: BloodRayne automatically discards empty guns and likewise will not pick up any.  Empty guns do not flash.
chinese: 莱恩会自动丢弃空枪，也不会拾取没有弹药的枪械，空枪不会闪光。

english: Rayne: I'm no gun collector either.  If I find something better, I'm trading.
chinese: 莱恩：我也不收藏枪，找到更好的就会换掉。

english: Rayne automatically keeps inventory optimal according to fire power versus ammo count; hit 'start' and go to options to adjust pickup settings.

莱恩：所以……你最喜欢哪种？

english: Rayne: Good bye stealth, welcome brute strength.
chinese: 莱恩：告别潜行，迎接蛮力。

english: Some weapons are "Special" because they have unique properties like short range, wide damage cone, 100% accuracy, etc.  The last slot in BloodRayne's inventory is reserved for these.
chinese: 部分武器因具备短射程、大范围伤害、100%命中率等独特性能而被归为“特殊”武器，\n莱恩携带栏的最后一个位置专门用于此类武器

speaker: Mynce

chinese: 明斯：怎么说呢，我可是“大爆炸理论”的拥护者。

english: Feeding not only restores Rayne's health, it also eliminates an enemy, and you can rotate the victim to block bullets.
chinese: 吸血不仅能恢复莱恩的生命值，还能消灭一名敌人；\n你还可以转动受害者，用其身体阻挡子弹。

english: Use Dilated perception when encountering large numbers of enemies. This gives you ample time to plan each attack.
chinese: 遭遇大批敌人时使用延时视觉，这能让你有充足时间规划每次攻击。

english: Strafe back and forth while fighting. Enemies have difficulty aiming at a moving target.
chinese: 战斗时来回平移，敌人很难瞄准移动中的目标。

english: If Rayne is hurt and outnumbered, don't be afraid to retreat.
chinese: 如果莱恩受伤且寡不敌众，不要害怕撤退。

english: Use the harpoon with care. It leaves Rayne exposed and does not work on powerful characters.
chinese: 谨慎使用鱼叉，使用鱼叉时莱恩会暴露在攻击下，而且鱼叉对强大的角色无效。

english: When there are no doors to open, look for cracks in the walls.
chinese: 没有门可以打开时，试着找找墙上的裂缝。

english: Some vehicles have heavy mounted weapons that you can take with you.
chinese: 有些载具装有重型固定武器，你可以将其拆下带走。

english: Use Aura Vision and your compass if you ever get lost.
chinese: 迷路时使用灵气视觉和指南针。

english: If Rayne runs out of guns, return to dead bodies for weapons she may have left behind.
chinese: 如果莱恩用光了枪械，可以回到尸体旁，捡取她先前丢下的武器。

english: If Rayne is at full health and a soldier is running away, you might want to let him go. You never know when Rayne might need a light snack later.
chinese: 如果莱恩的生命值已满，而一名士兵正在逃跑，或许可以放他一马，\n谁知道莱恩之后会不会需要一份小点心呢。

english: If Rayne is in an elevated position with a good view of her enemies, she can use Extruded View to place her bullets accurately and pick off her opponents one at a time.
chinese: 如果莱恩身处高处，能清楚地俯瞰敌人，\n她可以使用穿透视觉进行精确射击，逐个消灭对手。

english: Rayne has many foes. Sometimes her enemies are more interested in fighting each other than fighting Rayne. Let conflicting sides weaken each other before jumping into the fray.
chinese: 莱恩树敌众多，有时敌人更热衷于互相厮杀，而不是攻莱恩。\n先让敌对双方彼此削弱，再加入战斗。

english: Rayne not only runs fast; she also jumps high. She can quickly get out of trouble if she needs to. Remember to think about leaping up, not just running away.
chinese: 莱恩不仅跑得快，跳得也高。\n必要时，她可以迅速脱离险境。\n别只想着逃跑，也要记得向上跳。

english: Deep water rapidly damages Rayne. Stay high and dry as often as possible. Don't run through it if you can jump over it.
chinese: 深水会迅速伤害莱恩，尽量待在高处和干燥地带。\n能跳过去时，就不要直接从水里跑过。

english: When Rayne fights soldiers, the rebound kick (double-tap the Jump button) will often disarm them. Rayne can snatch his gun out of the air before it hits the ground.
chinese: 莱恩与士兵战斗时，反弹踢（连续按两次跳跃键）通常能使对方缴械。\n枪落地前，莱恩可以在空中将其夺走。
